product_one_liner.value: DesignArena lets people create and compare AI-generated designs and vote on model outputs, helping users discover which AI models best fit creative tasks while benchmarking design capability.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes creation with AI models; its methodology explains blind pairwise voting and evaluation.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer provides no pricing link; available main links cover leaderboards, models and methodology.

named_customers.notes: No company customer/case-study page or two named customer references was found. Public descriptions mention frontier labs generically, which is insufficient to name customers.

employee_band.notes: The YC profile reports three employees, below the bands offered; no source established a count in any permitted band.

hq_location.notes: YC identifies the team as based in San Francisco; LinkedIn lists San Francisco headquarters.

founded_year.notes: YC identifies the company as founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple technical/build posts, including a post describing and open-sourcing the slides generation pipeline and another explaining Fullstack Arena methodology.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes an introduction and API-reference documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live job board lists open positions; search results include an Applied AI Engineer role. Its employer is Arena Intelligence, the company behind DesignArena.

model_provider.value: The platform publicly lists a broad range of third-party model providers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Black Forest Labs, and others; it does not designate one exclusive provider powering the product.
model_provider.notes: The provider terms and model directory enumerate providers/models being evaluated; this is not evidence that one provider exclusively powers the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The security page explicitly names both certifications.

last_funding.notes: The company behind DesignArena announced a $7.9 million seed round on August 3, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 seed round occurred within the 18 months preceding November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board is open and lists roles, but the available listings do not show a role titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog lists an October 15, 2026 announcement introducing the Audio Realism Benchmark, inside the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A sufficiently complete team history or dated announcement/profile establishing a C-level or VP-level join or departure within the window was not found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job board, public docs and model directory reviewed did not name CRM or sales/marketing systems.
